CONFIDENCE: 0.34
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows:  
• Strong C–H stretches at 2870-3000 cm⁻¹ → alkyl groups (most candidates fit).  
• A very strong band at 769 cm⁻¹, typical of an aromatic ring out-of-plane deformation; only candidates 3 and 7 contain an aromatic ring.  
• Medium bands at 585 and 523 cm⁻¹ together with a strong 1033 cm⁻¹ band match PO₄/PO₃ vibrations (GFQ-024), indicating a phosphoryl group; this is present in candidates 7 and 8, but absent in 3.  
• A band at 1188 cm⁻¹ coincides with the characteristic symmetric S=O stretch of sulfones (~1150-1200 cm⁻¹; GFQ-005), and only candidate 7 has an SO₂ (sulfone) group.  
• The 1690 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with an amide C=O stretch, present in 7.  
Thus the simultaneous presence of P=O / P–O–C modes (523–1033 cm⁻¹), sulfone S=O stretch (1188 cm⁻¹), an aromatic ring deformation (769 cm⁻¹), and an amide carbonyl (1690 cm⁻¹) is uniquely satisfied by candidate 7 (CCOP(=O)(CN(C)S(=O)(=O)c1conc1C)OCC).
